Specification: This module specifies a very small state machine with a single variable f. The initial state sets f to a function whose domain is the two-element set of integer pairs <<1, 3>> and <<2, 4>>, and whose value on each pair is the sum of the pair components. The only transition action is stuttering, expressed as UNCHANGED f, so the specification models a constant function-valued state with no updates or fault behavior.
